_note: Verification contacts, for the manual-check worksheet. EMPTY BY DEFAULT and
filled by the operator, never by inference.
A registrar's address cannot be guessed from an institution's name, and a wrong
one sends a candidate's personal details to a stranger. So an institution absent
from this file produces no contact at all, and the worksheet names the office by
role — 'academic / examinations section' — for the reviewer to find themselves.
Each entry: names[] are matched case-insensitively as substrings of the
institution as written on the CV.
